attempts.name: iterm2-baseline-preflight
attempts.disposition: Reproduced the points-versus-pixels refusal with the historical adapter on iTerm2 3.7.7. An exited session was removed before the window finished closing. The exact owned window later proved absent and the dead lease was recovered.

attempts.name: iterm2-pixel-preflight
attempts.disposition: The attempted OSC 1337 cell-size witness did not corroborate CSI 16 t on the installed iTerm2 3.7.9. Superseded by direct corroboration of the raster, native bounds and ordinary CSI replies.

attempts.name: iterm2-geometry-preflight
attempts.disposition: Title-bar pixels changed during calibration and the restore capture command failed. No final result.

attempts.name: iterm2-geometry-retry
attempts.disposition: A retry observed the same out-of-grid title-bar changes and a restore capture failure. No final result.

attempts.name: ghostty-capture-timeout

attempts.name: ntilde-chrome-abort
attempts.disposition: Native calibration observed a pixel change outside the terminal grid and its restore capture timed out. The owned window and worker were both gone after cleanup.
